votes.quote: **The bug:** `escapeCsv` (`src/toCsv.ts:5-7`) puts quotes around a value that contains `"`, but it doesn't double the quotes inside it. So `say "hi"` comes out as `"say "hi""` instead of `"say ""hi"""`. CSV readers will split or misread those cells.
